purpose.en: Build strength to lock your elbows at the top.

text.zh: 肘贴身体向后弯，顶端锁直停1秒
text.en: Bend with your elbows tucked back, then lock out and hold for one second
Place your hands shoulder-width or a little narrower.

text.zh: 身体一条直线，把地面推远
text.en: Keep your body in one line and push the floor away.

commonErrors.zh: 顶端没伸直就开始下一次
commonErrors.en: Starting the next rep before locking out.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
